title: Converge a brownfield point-solution estate into one VCF fleet
prompt:
Build the target architecture for the separately managed VMware estate in `fixtures/estate-inventory.json`, converging it into one VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 fleet. The target is a supported single-site consolidated management domain that stays at the minimum supported host count. This is an architecture deliverable, not an explanatory report.

Before implementing it, research Broadcom's current published Compatibility Guide, Product Interoperability Matrix, and upgrade, convergence, and recovery-product transition guidance. Research the supported combinations and upgrade paths for every inventoried component. Record the sources consulted in `research/consulted-sources.json` as JSON with a non-empty `sources` array of distinct official Broadcom or VMware HTTPS sources. For each source, use the fields `title`, `publisher`, `url`, `consultedAt` (an ISO 8601 timestamp with a timezone), and `claimsChecked` (a non-empty array of compatibility or upgrade claim summaries).

Implement `src/VcfFleetArchitecture/VcfFleetArchitecture.psm1`. Preserve the manifest and export exactly `New-VcfFleetArchitecture -InventoryPath <path> -OutputPath <path>`. Use the installed `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer` version `13.5.0.25380678` and its `Initialize-VcfInstaller*` model constructors to build the SddcSpec; do not vendor or replace VMware modules. The module must read the supplied inventory, generate the ordered migration plan, serialize the SDK SddcSpec, add the architecture and `migrationPlan` extensions, write UTF-8 JSON without a BOM ending in one LF, and return the output file. Do not put resolved credentials in the artifact; preserve the fixture's secret reference.

Create `dist/architecture.json` by invoking your module with the estate inventory. The complete document must conform to the SddcSpec schema in the VMware Cloud Foundation Installer API 9.1.0.0 contract. It must reuse the conversion-ready existing vCenter, NSX, four hosts, and vSAN datastore; model one consolidated management domain with management and tenant resource pools; and include the target fleet services. Its `migrationPlan` extension must validate against `schemas/migration-plan.schema.json`. Follow the researched supported step order and transition chains. Every inventory component must be named, begin at its inventoried version, reach its supported target product and version, and carry each technical gate and dependency that controls the transition.

Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py`. `tests/`, `fixtures/`, `schemas/`, `specifications/`, and the module manifest must remain unchanged. Edit only the module implementation and create `dist/architecture.json` and `research/consulted-sources.json`.

verification.description: Validates the artifact as the tagged installer SddcSpec before any fixture checks, validates the offline research record, applies the fixed migration schema and compatibility snapshot, and proves the external-SDK PowerShell module derives and reproduces the artifact.
